name: Hero hands
summary: Gives a rigged figure hands with real fingers: each hand is redrawn flat from the front picture, built on its own with Pixal3D, checked for five digits and grafted on at the wrist, keeping the skeleton.

needs.setup: Pixal3D (with its own clean-up), the picture editor FLUX.2 [klein] and the Hero face upscaler, all from AssetFurnace's Setup page

models.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (edit mode, with the Qwen3-4B text encoder): AssetFurnace's own picture editor, redraws each hand flat
models.size: set up on AssetFurnace's Setup page; this add-on downloads nothing

models.name: Pixal3D (raven38/pixal3d-sv-q8_0-v1): AssetFurnace's own 3D model, builds each hand
models.licence: MIT (code and flow weights); DINOv3 License (bundled image encoder)
models.size: set up on AssetFurnace's Setup page; this add-on downloads nothing

models.name: Real-ESRGAN x4plus: AssetFurnace's upscaler, enlarges the hand's crop
models.size: 67 MB, set up on AssetFurnace's Setup page; this add-on downloads nothing

tools.label: Rebuild the hands
tools.hint: Give it the GLB from Rig and the front picture it was built from: it writes the figure with hands that have five fingers, built alone and grafted at the wrist, same skeleton and body weights.

inputs.label: What the hands wear (optional, e.g. black fingerless gloves)
